newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha firm, crude, Skikda closure supportive.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha firm, crude, Skikda closure supportive.

text.p: NWE naphtha was notionally firmer on Monday, with both physical and paper talked $4-$5 a tonne higher, traders said.

Open spec cargoes were discussed in the mid to high $220s, with the closure of Algeria's Skikda oil port, strong crude futures, and good petchem demand the main factors underpinning the market, traders said.
On the barges, full-range product was offered at fob quotes high +$1 fob ARA.
Swaps climbed high with crude to talk around 214/215 cif NWE for Nov. -- Rosalind Russell, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5387
